title: Inter-agency Coordination to Support Timely Deployment of EV Charging Infrastructure in New Housing Estates
what_it_is: Inter-agency Coordination to Support Timely Deployment of EV Charging Infrastructure in New Housing Estates

sections.label: EV charging points deployment target
sections.summary: Government targets 60,000 EV charging points by 2030, with 30,500 deployed as of March 2026.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The Government targets to deploy 60,000 electric vehicle (EV) charging points by 2030, which comprise 40,000 in public car parks, and 20,000 in private premises.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: As of March 2026, there are 30,500 EV charging points deployed in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: We are on track to achieving our 2030 target in tandem with the growing demand for EVs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) monitors EV adoption rates closely and coordinates with agencies such as the Energy Market Authority, the Housing and Development Board (HDB) and JTC to deploy EV charges and key supporting infrastructure.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: By end 2027, there will also be at least one fast charging hub in every HDB town.

sections.label: Tengah EV chargers and new BTOs
sections.summary: Two Tengah car parks have EV chargers, eight more are being deployed, and new BTOs get chargers from key collection.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Currently, two multi-storey car parks in Tengah have EV chargers, and LTA subsidiary, EV-Electric (EVe) Charging Pte Ltd, is in the process of deploying EV chargers in another eight multi-storey car parks in Tengah.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: We have taken into account the feedback from Tengah residents and are improving the process for new Build-To-Order (BTO) estates.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: So, for instance, starting from BTOs that obtained Temporary Occupation Permit (TOP) since last month, there is now a new arrangement, where LTA subsidiary EVe works closely with HDB to start deploying EV chargers from the point that residents start collecting their keys – so, at the point of TOP.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: This will allow residents moving into new BTO estates to actually gain access to EV chargers earlier.
